date_caption: Created August 28, 2026 for the 35th week of 2026.

news.title: Meta’s $18bn settlement: How social platforms will change for child users - Al Jazeera

weekly_forecast: This week, as Meta imposes a two-hour limit on kids, expect a surge in underground 'gramming—teenagers will start smuggling TikTok dances into Instagram DMs like contraband candy. Parents will suddenly become tech experts overnight, pretending they always knew what 'algorithm' meant. Meanwhile, Zuckerberg will be spotted testing a new 'nap time' feature for adults, because capitalism never sleeps (but your data does).

signs.name: Aries
lines: You'll rage against the two-hour limit by posting 37 Stories in 60 minutes.
Your impulsive DMs will now come with a 'Are you sure?' pop-up—finally, a worthy adversary.

signs.name: Taurus
lines: You’ll stubbornly refuse to log off, even after the app forcibly closes.
Your meme stash is too precious to abandon. The algorithm fears your taste.

signs.name: Gemini
lines: You’ll exploit the loophole by juggling three 'child' accounts simultaneously.
Finally, a valid reason for your split personality.

signs.name: Cancer
lines: You’ll panic and start archiving every post 'just in case.'
Your mood swings now sync with Instagram’s downtime notifications.

signs.name: Leo
lines: You’ll protest the curfew by livestreaming your dramatic bedtime routine.
The spotlight doesn’t turn off at 9 PM, Karen.

signs.name: Virgo
lines: You’ve already color-coded your remaining screen time into a spreadsheet.
The 'gram’s new limits? Just another system to optimize.

signs.name: Libra
lines: You’ll spend your two hours deliberating which filter is ~most fair~.
Justice is blind, but your selfie game is not.

signs.name: Scorpio
lines: You’ll hack the parental controls before breakfast. No one cages the scorpion.
Your search history? Deleted. Your secrets? Eternal.

signs.name: Sagittarius
lines: You’ll use your limited time to argue with strangers about astrology.
Wanderlust now includes 'exploring' the depths of Twitter threads.

signs.name: Capricorn
lines: You’ll monetize your remaining screen time by selling curated 'vibe checks.'
Even playtime is a grindset opportunity.

signs.name: Aquarius
lines: You’ll invent a grassroots movement to overthrow the time limit.
Revolution looks like a pixelated meme—your followers will understand.

signs.name: Pisces
lines: You’ll accidentally log into your 'secret fanfic account' during family time.
The algorithm knows you cried at that cat video. It always knows.
